column7: A user suspended right after re-authenticating kept a short-lived re-auth step-up grant: SuspendUser did not purge grants and consuming one did not check the account was active. Every account-disabling path (suspend and the other setAccountStateInTx callers, UpdateUser deactivation, DeleteUser, SCIM deprovision/deactivate, RevokeUserCredentialsForDeactivation) now deletes the user's grants right after the disable commits (best-effort; a leftover grant is refused at use), and requireReauth re-reads the account before spending a grant (TestRequireReauth_GrantCreatedAfterSuspend_RefusedAtUse covers a grant inserted after the purge). Found by AUTH-VERIFY-1.
